summary: I read the inventory reservation code. ensureInventoryLevels (packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts, lines 173-192) checks each reservation input separately against available_quantity and never sums inputs that share an inventory item and location, which matches the report's per-line-check cause. createReservationItems_ (line 303) also writes reserved_quantity as an absolute value from an earlier read, which matches stale-counter-write, but I did not test the cross-process case. I submitted one scenario (attempt 2) for the multi-line oversell. The harness has not reported its result, so I am not claiming a confirmed finding yet. The code reading supports the per-line-check finding, but I have not verified it by running the scenario.
